name: smwmusic-sora-gray-hued
title: Sora - Gray Hued
description:
Track 04 of Sora. This game was developed by Fruit Bat Factory, who also developed the game 100% Orange Juice.

This techo song fits the setting when used in an abstract environment, or a space level.

(EDIT: The piano tracks sound much better this time around. Also made a few changes to some of the track. Size went down a little.)
